Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has opposite sides parallel and adjacent sides perpendicular, but adjacent sides are unequal in length. What is the most specific name? ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Perpendicular adjacent sides give right angles. Together with opposite sides parallel this makes a rectangle. Unequal adjacent sides exclude a square and rhombus.

Question Choices: Fill: A rhombus always belongs to the quadrilateral family defined by two pairs of parallel opposite sides: a __.
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Every rhombus has two pairs of parallel opposite sides, satisfying the parallelogram definition.

Question Choices: Select. Is a rhombus always a rectangle? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: No. A rhombus can have four equal sides and angles 60°,120°,60°,120°. It lacks the four right angles needed for a square or rectangle.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "Every square is a rhombus, but not every rhombus is a square" ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: Every square has four equal sides, so it is a rhombus. A rhombus with angles 60°,120°,60°,120° is not a square because its angles are not right. TRUE.

Question Choices: A designer crafts a custom glass window pane with four straight sides. All four sides are exactly equal length, but none of the corners form a 90-degree right angle. What is the most specific name for this window's shape? : Rectangle Rhombus Trapezoid
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Without four right angles it is neither a rectangle nor a square.
